channel.title: Pinwei — discover agent skills with taste
channel.description: A daily-restocked shelf of agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents — each one with what it actually does, who it is for, and the one-line install command. Skills are picked by hand from public repositories; the shelf favours the ones that are fun or genuinely useful over the ones that merely exist.

item.title: vintage-travel-ticket
item.description: A design grammar distilled from 66 historical tickets — archetype, illustration, palette, paper, type, information layout, print ageing — one coherent set picked at random each time.

item.title: outsider-art
item.description: Large flat color zones each carrying one hand-made texture, tiny faceless silhouette figures doing ordinary things; paper white, warm ink black, 2–4 scene colors plus exactly one saturated highlight.

item.title: eli5
item.description: The whole body is one line: explain like I know nothing, as an HTML page with big pictures and few words.

item.title: bigfish-ink-wash-photo
item.description: Not reconstruction — only essential identifying anchors; canvas direction is decided from the photo's subject extension and visual center before generating.

item.title: tait-crt-interface-skill
item.description: An exaggerated bitmap editorial caricature beneath early Macintosh / Minitel-style windows, barrel-curved CRT edges, three Chinese presets.

item.title: starryear-threefold-memory
item.description: Top: the photo recomposed as large fragments of visual memory. Middle: the untouched photo as evidence. Bottom: route, direction and mood drawn as a memory map.

item.title: deconstructed-duotone-poster
item.description: Four fixed layouts (3:4 nine-square, 3:4 four-panel, 4:3 six-square, 4:3 four-panel) with locked coordinates; ivory paper plus one ink of your choice.

item.title: dnr-flat-pic
item.description: Semantic compression, not tracing: keep identity and spatial relations, remove gradients, glow, texture, text and logos, cap complexity at 6/10.

item.title: arch-kele-structure-photo
item.description: Two outputs per photo: a clean structural-study artwork, and one with the untouched source inset top-right. Warm paper, construction lines, restrained labels, palette derived from the photo.

item.title: itr-wala
item.description: From Form 16 to old-vs-new regime, plus Zerodha capital gains—one skill for FY25-26 ITR. No more ten tabs for 80C.

item.title: a2ui-renderer

item.title: comfyui-mcp

item.title: trading-design
item.description: A design system for trading software — panel layouts, data density, market color semantics and interaction rules.

item.title: archify
item.description: Validated architecture, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams — self-contained HTML with motion, crisp exports.

item.title: planning-with-files
item.description: Plans live as Markdown on disk — surviving crashes, /clear and compaction; work resumes from the exact checkpoint every time.

item.title: goldie

item.title: tastemaker

item.title: cove-tarot-companion
item.description: Need an offline tarot ritual? Draw a card, revisit past readings, or invite one naturally in companion chats. For.

item.title: easy-humanizer-zh
